Each team uses 4 balls that are different colors, and the goal of the game is to get the balls as close as possible to the pallino (The small target ball). Every round is played from one side of the court and starts with the pallino being rolled onto the court. Basic Rules: Every roll (including the pallino) must happen as stated below in order to remain on the court: All players' feet must be behind the foot fault line. The ball can only be thrown underhand and the roll must go beyond th half court line. The ball can only make contact with the back wall only if it makes contact with another ball. The ball cannot be thrown higher than head height. When the pallino is thrown if the pallino does not go beyond the half court line the other team will begin the round. The team who gets the ball closest to the pallino is “in” and the other team is “out.” In order to complete the round the team that is “out” throws until they are “in” or out of bocce balls. The round ends when all of their bocce balls are thrown by all competitors. The balls are allowed ot strike other balls, the pallino or the sidewall during play. The teams can decide the roation or order of play. Scoring: Only the team with the ball closest to the pallino scores in that round, they recieve 1 point for each ball that is closer to the pallino than the opponents. If two balls are the same distance apart from the pallino at the end of a round, the next closest ball breaks the tie. A ball that is ends touching the pallino is counted as two points. The team that scores in the first round gets to throw the pallino and the first bocce ball throw in the next round. The first team to reach 11 points--and win by 2 points--wins that game.
